anya: quick RFC follow-up: propose a compact onprem registry prune playbook for air-gapped sites. feedback? :wave:

kyle: what are the main failure modes?

anya: 1) concurrent prune controllers deleting blobs still referenced by running pods. 2) operator crashes leaving partial GC state/tombstones. both can break pods in an airgapped site.

maria: also big deletes spike disk IO; need throttling and chunking.

anya: proposed flow: lease CRD (prune-lock.<site>) -> candidate discovery -> annotate `prune.redwood.io/candidate=true` dry-run -> wait window (default 15m) -> tombstone `prune.redwood.io/tombstone=true` retain 24h -> chunked, rate-limited blob delete with checkpointing -> remove tombstone.

devon: how do we handle operator OOM after claiming lease?

anya: CRD stores ownerRef + heartbeat. operator updates heartbeat; if stale beyond lease_grace another operator can force-claim. tombstones act as safety: can rehydrate within retain window.

kyle: defaults: lease_grace=90s, heartbeat=20s, dry-run=15m, tombstone-retain=24h, chunk-size=500, delete-rate=10/s. expose as config.

maria: offer optional node-agent (registry-prober) to report in-use blobs for extra safety; keep optional.

registry-bot: prune-preview scheduled site=aurora at 2026-03-22T16:12Z

devon: add `last_deleted_hash` checkpoint to CRD so deletes resume if operator changes.

anya: will add checkpoint and a `prune-preview` API for console that returns manifests/blobs and estimated reclaim. CLI `redwoodctl registry prune --site X [--dry-run]` and `redwoodctl registry restore --site X` for rehydrate.

maria: include a runbook for emergency rehydrate from local snapshot. reduces TTR.

kyle: tests: stress harness (10k images), simulate operator kill mid-run, verify no missing blobs and resume works.

anya: action items: I will draft RFC + CRD schema; kyle picks defaults; maria designs preview UI; devon builds harness. will post RFC link here when ready.

registry-bot: prune-preview completed (dry-run) site=aurora candidates=289 reclaim=34GB

anya: thanks all, closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
